scientific_quote: Meal context improves uptake of long-chain omega-3 in lipid matrices.
Phospholipid omega-3 forms can improve utilization efficiency.
Glucosamine uptake is measurable across dosing contexts with modest variability.
MSM oral utilization improves in complete meal context.
Zinc utilization declines in high-phytate contexts and improves with lower inhibitory load.
Consistent daily intake improves probiotic survival and functional persistence.
